cards.title: HQ freshness watch
cards.what: Each morning, checks that the published HQ page matches the local boulon-hq.html and that the Today, Week and Now tabs show this week; pings only if something is stale.
cards.saves: No more finding out HQ is a week behind; about 3 manual catch-up republishes a week
cards.evidence: 5 times: 10-27 (69b65613, Week tab still on 10-05 plan), 10-28 (017011e7 at 13:41 'a week late', 13:45, 14:36 Now tab outdated), 10-29 (b794cb22 at 09:43 republish)

cards.title: Unsent messages reminder
cards.what: Lists the French messages Claude drafted for Pierre, Gabriel or Henri that Greg has not marked as sent yet, so none sit forgotten.
cards.when: Weekdays 09:00, only if at least one draft is waiting
cards.saves: Keeps drafts from being lost; avoids re-drafting the same message later
cards.evidence: 8 drafts: 10-28 (017011e7, 5 drafts and redrafts for Pierre between 13:03 and 14:30), 10-29 (b794cb22 at 16:26 Gabriel, 16:43 Pierre, 11:12 Pierre); 10-29 digest says 2 still unsent

cards.title: Company-certificate check on new scripts
cards.what: Scans scripts and launchers changed this week for Node, pip or uv calls missing the system-certificate setting, and lists any it finds before they fail.
cards.saves: Catches the SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN failure before it costs a run; it was re-diagnosed 5 times this week
cards.evidence: 5 times: 10-27 (8b4562ac at 11:20, uv), 10-29 (1a951f7a at 10:32 pip, 10:35 Python, 10:48 Node; e8f86a95 at 10:41, 10 of 10 failing in wm.cmd)

cards.title: End-of-day double-run guard
cards.what: Before end of day starts, checks whether it already ran or is running today and stops the second copy, so you only get one close.
cards.when: Each time end of day starts (manual or the 16:45 routine)
cards.saves: No more overlapping or duplicated day-closes; it happened 6 times in 2 days
